reader.requirement: At --std 85 a group-level VALUE takes only a figurative constant or a nonnumeric literal no longer than the group, initializes the group's whole area as characters without regard to the subordinate items' descriptions (on every storage lane: the typed record-struct fields and the character-image backing of a redefined group), and a VALUE on any data item subordinate to that group is refused (condition-names excepted).
reader.edition-search: grep of ImageInitializer.cs, GroupImageCodec.cs, BitImageCodec.cs, GroupValueSlicer.cs and OccurrenceRunEmit.cs for Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior: none. The image composer reads VALUE clauses through ValueInitializer (its InitializerFrom DialectLevel arm is numeric-edited ZERO only, not on these paths). DataBinder.ValidateValueCategory's only edition consult is on the numeric elementary arm.

reader.notes: PB2337 split GroupImageCodec into GroupImageCodec (the run-time AsImage/FromImage codec), BitImageCodec and ImageInitializer (the compile-time initial-image composer); AreaImageOf, ImageInitOf and OccurrenceRunsOf moved with their bodies unchanged to ImageInitializer, wired by DataEmitter (PhysicalModel.Images) and reached from the Tier-B backing seed and GroupValueSlicer.MemberFromSlice (BackingSeedOver). Re-read at the branch head against the 1985 text. CarrierInitOfOne's group arm asks GroupValueSlicer.AreaOf (the one GR3 area rule both lanes share) and returns AreaImageOf(item, area), which for a character group is the area expression itself; the member-wise composition is not reached. BackingSeedOver hands an enclosing group's slice to AreaImageOf for a group member that is a Tier-B canonical. Every probed form agrees with the 1985 text, with no edition branch on the path.

refuter.evidence: Code read independently at the branch head: ImageInitializer.cs carries AreaImageOf, ImageInitOf and OccurrenceRunsOf with no edition read (grep Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel|ConstructRegistry|IsAtLeast|DialectBehavior over ImageInitializer, GroupImageCodec, BitImageCodec, GroupValueSlicer, OccurrenceRunEmit: none); GroupImageCodec.cs keeps only the run-time AsImage/FromImage codec, which seeds nothing. Attack on the path the reader did not probe, a group VALUE whose MEMBER is the canonical of a REDEFINES (BackingSeedOver -> CarrierInitOfOne's governing arm -> AreaImageOf over the enclosing slice): r1.cob at --std 85 01 G1 VALUE "ABCDEF" with 05 H1 (A1, B1) redefined by 05 H1R (C1 PIC X(4)) and 05 D1 printed G1 [ABCDEF] C1 [ABCD] B1 [CD] D1 [EF]; 01 G4 VALUE ALL "Q" over X OCCURS 4 + PIC 9 under an alias printed R4 [QQQQQ] U4 [Q]; 01 G5 VALUE ZEROS over X OCCURS 3 + 99 printed R5 [00000] U5=00. The area is set as characters without regard to the members, as GR3 says; the same at --std 2023.
